raw_checkpoint_audit.scope: raw stored safetensors tensors, including buffers, compared by name and shape
raw_checkpoint_audit.interpretation: Numeric equality and tolerance use all stored reference elements. Tolerance is abs(candidate - reference) <= atol + rtol * abs(reference). Raw relative L2 requires full reference name and shape coverage. The zero-filled score substitutes zeros for missing or shape-incompatible tensors. Candidate extras are outside the scores. Serialized names can differ when checkpoints save tied weights under different aliases. This audit compares stored values without resolving aliases or aligning symmetries.
